title: Model Landscape Competitive Galaxy & Tactical Recon Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, multi-dimensional \"competitive galaxy\" mapping and a lightweight tactical recon playbook that PMs and Solutions Engineers can run weekly to triage new model entrants, produce prioritized experiment recommendations (lab probes), and surface procurement/compatibility signals to the sourcing team. The output should translate model-level changes into concrete product decisions (pin/recommend/blacklist), rollout guidance, and risk notes for Dedicated/Private customers.
background: We frequently receive signals about new open models, quantized variants, and cloud-hosted offerings. Current tracking is ad-hoc (spreadsheets + Slack). This makes it hard to answer: which models deserve an onboarding spike, which require immediate compatibility work, and which pose an enterprise procurement risk. Engineering and Solutions have asked for a concise playbook and a prioritized set of probes they can run without deep model engineering effort.
proposed_solution: Build a structured 'galaxy' visualization that positions models along curated axes (latency, cost per token, license risk, quantization friendliness, regional availability, inference ROI). Pair this with a tactical recon checklist and a prioritized lab probe matrix (small reproducible tests: embed latency sweep, RAG retrieval fidelity, quantized case edge-cases, privacy/PII hallucination probes). Automate signal ingestion from public model releases, OSS repos, benchmark crawlers, and partner feeds; output a weekly digest and a ranked backlog of PM/Eng actions.
tasks: Define galaxy axes and scoring rubric (PM + Research + Eng)
Prototype galaxy visualization in Observable/Looker Studio and validate with 3 sample models
Draft tactical recon checklist and standard lab probe scripts (python notebooks + Docker)
Create ingestion pipelines for public model metadata (license files, repo tags, published benchmarks)
Integrate a lightweight alert rule for high-risk license changes or new enterprise-incompatible variants
Run a 2-week pilot with Solutions Engineering on 6 candidate models and capture probe outcomes
Synthesize pilot findings into prioritized roadmap items (onboard, monitor, deprioritize)
Deliver a one-page playbook and an internal training session for PMs and AE/SEs
acceptance_criteria: Galaxy visualization available and populated with >= 15 models across axes
Tactical recon checklist exists with at least 5 automated probe scripts and README
Pilot run completed and produced a prioritized set of 10 backlog actions with owners
Weekly digest automated and delivered to #pm-intel and #solutions with actionable summary
At least two downstream engineering tickets created from prioritized probe outcomes
success_metrics: Time from new-model-signal to prioritized recommendation < 7 days
% of urgent procurement signals resolved or handed to sourcing within 14 days >= 80%
Reduction in PM/SE ad-hoc recon time by 60% (measured via self-reporting + time logs)
Number of models with documented compatibility notes increases by 200% in 3 months
